ignore_rules.rationale: Git administrative bytes are not application declarations.
Nested JavaScript dependency bytes are not first-party declarations.
Nested third-party dependency bytes are not first-party declarations.
Distribution output is derived and is not a declaration authority.
Build output is derived and is not a declaration authority.
Turbo cache bytes are generated build state.
Tool cache bytes are generated build state.
Legacy application cache is generated execution state.
Legacy root cache is generated execution state.
Legacy var cache is generated execution state.
Legacy var data is generated runtime state.
Legacy application logs are execution evidence.
Legacy root logs are execution evidence.
Legacy var logs are execution evidence.
Nested npm debug logs are execution evidence.
Coverage output is test evidence, not parity authority.
